about: Modern IAF's key table: the 117 commands of docs/controls.md §3 with our own labels (record 23, the 1998 game's drag chute, an empty slot since 2026-11-18: no Modern IAF jet has one), our own 118th, Start engine (command 200, a hidden developer shortcut, modern-iaf/docs/training.md §7), record 118 the Checklist notebook (command 203 on H, modern-iaf/docs/training.md §11; until 2026-11-13 the in-flight mission card, removed; the HUD brightness stays on Shift + H), the start-up checklist's steps (records 119–124, commands 210–215, training.md §7.1; the throttle moved up from OFF is the idle step; record 121, Throttle OFF, command 218 on Shift + 1: the engine shutdown, training.md §7.2), the F-16's up-front controls, HUD panel and DGFT / MSL OVRD switch (records 152–178, commands 250–254, modern-iaf/docs/ufc.md), the EW and identification keys (records 179–190, commands 260–264, and record 191, the IFF IDENT, command 255; modern-iaf/docs/ews.md), Master arm (record 125, command 202 on Shift + A, modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §3), Hide pilot's body (records 192 hold on Alt + H, 193 toggle on Alt + G, command 205, modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.3), the HUD control panel's SCALES, FP MARKER, VELOCITY and ALT (records 194–197 on Alt + X / F / Z / A, command 252 p1 0–3, p2 -1 the next position round; modern-iaf/docs/ufc.md), and the 3D cockpit's lean (records 126–131, command 204: p1 the axis 0 right / 1 up / 2 aft, p2 the way, its release p2 0; Shift + arrows and Shift + Page Up / Page Down, held: the head eases there and back on the release, shared/terrain/views.gd lean, modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §2); the full MFD view (records 198 / 199, command 207, p1 0 the left display, 1 the right one, on Shift + , / . (the < and > caps: left and right; until 2026-11-18 on Shift + N / M, where Shift + N took the night-vision goggles' key, shared/terrain/terrain_view.gd _own_key); the F-35I's one display on both; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §2); the SPD BRK switch (records 200 held / 201, command 206: p1 1 aft, open while held, its release 0; -1 forward, close; on B / Shift + B: the user, 2026-11-18, "B should be the airbrake"; the wheel brakes, record 22, held on W: command 17 with p1 1 on, its release -1 off, where the 1998 game's p1 0 flips them; W was Next waypoint, record 39, now on Shift + W, and Previous waypoint, record 40, moved from there to Shift + Q, the key beside it (Alt + W is the wingman's, Ctrl + W a debug key): the user, 2026-11-18; modern-iaf/docs/flight-model.md §9.11), the roll trim (records 202 / 203, command 230, p1 the way, held, on Alt + Left / Right), the MANUAL PITCH override (record 204, command 231, held, on Alt + M), the STORES CONFIG switch (record 205, command 232, on Alt + S) and the GPS bomb's PRE / VIS and next PRE target (records 206 / 207, commands 233 / 234, on K / Shift + K; docs/weapons.md §13.2): until 2026-11-18 keys the flight scene read by itself, with no row on the Keys screen; each listed record's "group" is its part of the Keys screen (modern-iaf/docs/front-end.md §9; no group: a command the sim lacks, not listed); compiled by iaf-sim own into assets/converted/own/keys.json (the shape shared/controls/key_table.gd reads). The joystick column: 0-based buttons; the hat is the 1998 game's POV, its eight directions the snap views (shared/controls/joystick.gd poll); a device map (modern-iaf/data/devices/) replaces the column for its joystick. One head-look set: the snap views (records 28-36; the hat sends the same views); records 74 and 86-93 (the 1998 game's rear view on F2 and free look on Shift + numpad / arrows) are empty slots, the mouse looks around freely (modern-iaf/docs/front-end.md §9.1); The laptop column: the key of the laptop map (a Mac laptop's keyboard: no numpad, no Insert / Delete / Home / End / Page Up / Page Down, and F11 is the system's; iaf-tools' test every_listed_command_has_a_key_on_a_mac_laptop; modern-iaf/docs/front-end.md §9.1), compiled into converted/own/keys_laptop.json; a record without it keeps its key there; records 132–142 the real F-16 FCR's keys (commands 221–227: the TMS, OSB 2's submode, the scan width and bars, the antenna elevation held, OVRD, EXP; docs/radar.md §9.4), the cursor on the EO slew keys (records 48–51); records 143–146 the FCR's ground-map OSBs (command 228, p1 the OSB: 7 FZ, 8 SP, 9 CZ, 10 STP / TGT; docs/radar.md §9.7); records 147–150 the DMS (command 240, p1 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right) and 151 LASER ARM (command 241) of the F-16's modern MFDs (docs/mfd.md §9 "Modern MFDs"); the fuel and brake switches (records 208–211, command 270: p1 0 PARKING BRAKE on Shift + G, 1 MASTER FUEL on Ctrl + F, 2 ENG FEED on Shift + E, 3 FUEL QTY SEL on Shift + U, p2 -1 the next position; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.7); the ICP's DRIFT C/O switch (records 212 / 213, command 252 p1 6: p2 -1 DRIFT C/O and NORM on Shift + J, 0 WARN RESET on Ctrl + R; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.8); the display knobs (records 214–218, command 271: p1 0 the ICP's CONT on Ctrl + H, 1 / 2 the left / right MFD's CON on Shift + 7 / 8, 3 / 4 their GAIN on Shift + 9 / 0, p2 0 a step down, round from the bottom to the top; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.8); the flight scene's own Ctrl + F-keys (records 219–221, until 2026-11-18 keys terrain_view.gd _own_key read by itself, with no row on the Keys screen): the quit box on Ctrl + F1 (command 134, Leave mission's), the cockpit / outside view on Ctrl + F2 (command 272) and the flight information line on Ctrl + F12 (command 273); the Checklist notebook's pages (records 222 / 223, command 203 p1 -1 the previous page, 1 the next, while it is raised, on Page Up / Page Down, the laptop map's Option + Space / Shift + Space; until 2026-11-18 keys modern-iaf/flight/kneeboard.gd read by itself; modern-iaf/docs/training.md §11); Shift + N, the 1998 game's night-vision goggles, has no record: Modern IAF has no goggles (Settings.night_vision is off there), so the key does nothing in the sim; the A-A missile seeker head (records 224 / 225, command 280: p1 0 UNCAGE / CAGE on Shift + M, 1 SPOT / SCAN on Ctrl + S; modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §8.1); the bombs' release submode, fuze and arming delay (records 226–228, command 290: p1 0 the next submode as the missile step switch, CCIP → DTOS → CCRP, on Ctrl + G, 1 the next fuze option on Alt + Q, 2 the next arming delay on Alt + 0) and the RET DEPR wheel (records 229 / 230, command 291: p1 1 the reticle 5 mr down on Ctrl + V, -1 up on Alt + V; modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §9); the F-16's own autopilot (modern-iaf/docs/research/f16-autopilot.md): its PITCH and ROLL switches a step up or down (records 231–234, command 292: p1 0 PITCH, 1 ROLL, p2 1 up, -1 down, on Shift + 2 / 3 / 4 / 5), the stick's paddle switch held (record 235, command 293, on Shift + I), TRIM/AP DISC (record 236, command 294, on Shift + 6) and FLCS RESET (record 237, command 295, on Ctrl + L); the navigation pod's TFR switches (records 238–239, command 242: p1 0 ADV MODE on Shift + F8, 1 MANUAL TF FLYUP on Shift + F9 (the paddle is record 235's, Shift + I, which also holds a TF fly-up off); the cursor keys, records 48–51, are the FLIR's snap-look while the HUD is the SOI; modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §7.4); record 240 an empty slot; the F-35I's panoramic display keys (records 241–249, command 300: p1 0 MENU, 1 / 2 its cursor on / back, 3 select, 4 the next window into the portal, 5 widen, 6 enlarge, 7 SWAP, 8 the next preset; docs/f35i.md §4.3) and its bay doors (record 250, command 301; modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §5).
